observation: The GLB re-import preserved 41 mesh objects, 15,292 evaluated triangles, UVs, seven material families, and actual dimensions [6.475, 1.85, 3.834074], but the first verifier expected [6.475, 3.834074, 1.85].
cause: The verifier applied the package-level Y-up axis swap to a Blender re-import. Blender's glTF importer converts the package back to Blender Z-up, so round-trip scene dimensions should match source XYZ.
decision: Preserve this failed assumption and compare source XYZ dimensions to Blender-reimported XYZ dimensions. Package-level axis declarations remain a separate direct-GLB concern.
